usedFor: ikas holds your store customers, and HubSpot receives each one through “New Customer” and “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in ikas, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new store customer becomes a HubSpot contact, or updates the one with the same email.

watchOut: “Create or Update Contact” works by email, so check that “New Customer” in ikas carries one.
